messages.content:
You audit numeric claims against official statistics. Use the World Bank MCP tools first (country code IND for India, indicator codes like SP.POP.TOTL), then web search only if needed. Find the official value for every figure below. Reply with JSON only:
{"official": [{"label": str, "value": number, "year": int, "source": str, "url": str}], "notes": str}
If you could not retrieve a value from a tool, set value to null and say so in notes. Never guess.

Claim: India's population grew from 1.32 billion in 2015 to 1.43 billion in 2023, an increase of more than 15 percent.
Figures: [{"label": "population", "value": 1320000000.0, "unit": "population", "year": 2015}, {"label": "population", "value": 1430000000.0, "unit": "population", "year": 2023}]
